decks.notes: This Gruul Aggro deck aims to aggressively push damage with efficient creatures and burn spells. The key strategy revolves around quickly establishing a board presence with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, while using burn spells like Burst Lightning and Play with Fire to clear the way or finish off opponents. The versatile utility of cards like Reckless Rage and Spikefield Hazard allows for maintaining control of the battlefield, while cards like Light Up the Stage provide card advantage to keep the pressure on. Overall, the deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays to overwhelm opponents quickly.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent using aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, while disrupting their game plan with removal spells like Fatal Push and Duress. The deck aims to control the board with powerful creatures and removal spells, while also utilizing cards like Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber to generate additional value. The inclusion of cards like Fear of Missing Out and Blade of the Oni provides additional reach and damage potential to close out games quickly.

The deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo by utilizing cards like Greasefang, Okiba Boss, Parhelion II, and Monument to Endurance. It includes support cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize for disruption and protection with Seasoned Hallowblade and Sheltered by Ghosts. The mana base consists of dual lands and utility lands to ensure smooth mana development. Overall, the deck aims to create a powerful combo engine while controlling the opponent's resources and protecting its key pieces.

This deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field to generate large amounts of mana quickly in order to cast powerful spells and abilities. It runs cards that allow for efficient ramp, such as Arboreal Grazer and Crumbling Vestige, while also including key pieces like Scapeshift to enable explosive combos. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and abilities, ultimately achieving victory through overwhelming mana advantage and powerful synergies.

Utilizing cheap cantrips and efficient spells to quickly fill the graveyard and bring back Arclight Phoenix for repeated attacks, overwhelming opponents with a fast and aggressive strategy. The deck focuses on synergy between spells and creatures to create a powerful board presence while maintaining card advantage and tempo. Additionally, includes disruptive elements and counter magic to control the game and protect the aggressive game plan.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures and disrupting your opponent with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats. The inclusion of powerful cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger can help to close out the game quickly if left unchecked. With a mix of efficient creatures, disruption, and removal, this deck aims to apply pressure early and force the opponent to react defensively.

This deck focuses on quickly disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Mutavault. It aims to control the board with removal spells such as Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, while utilizing powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes some versatile cards like Kolaghan's Command and Abrade to deal with various threats, making it a strong and versatile aggro deck in the Pioneer format.

This red aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with low-cost, aggressive creatures and burn spells. By efficiently using cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Emberheart Challenger to control the board and deal direct damage, while utilizing cards like Monstrous Rage and Heartfire Hero to pump up creatures and go for quick damage. The deck also includes utility lands like Ramunap Ruins and Mutavault for additional reach. Overall, the deck aims to pressure the opponent quickly and end the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This UW Control deck focuses on manipulating the opponent's resources and controlling the board through counterspells, card draw, and removal. It aims to outvalue opponents by generating card advantage with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Meticulous Archive, while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Dovin's Veto and removal spells like Supreme Verdict. The deck also utilizes versatile lands like Field of Ruin and Deserted Beach to further control the battlefield. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to control the game and outlast opponents through patient and strategic plays.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with cheap instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and deal quick damage to the opponent. It also includes cards like Treasure Cruise for card advantage and Temporal Trespass for extra turns. The deck utilizes a mix of removal spells and card draw spells to control the board while aggressively attacking with Arclight Phoenix. The deck also includes counterspells and a few versatile cards like Brazen Borrower for additional control options. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly through aggressive plays and graveyard recursion.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on using cheap removal spells like Fatal Push and Abrupt Decay to control the board while deploying threats like Gilded Goose and Cauldron Familiar. The deck also utilizes synergy between Witch's Oven and Scavenger's Talent to generate value and outpace the opponent. Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER and Ygra, Eater of All provide powerful late-game threats to close out the game. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive game plan, with a mix of dual lands and utility lands like Hive of the Eye Tyrant and Boseiju, Who Endures.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quick and efficient creature removal while applying pressure to the opponent. With a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push, Go for the Throat, and Thoughtseize, as well as powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while dealing consistent damage. The deck also includes utility lands like Mutavault and Blightstep Pathway to provide additional reach. Additionally, the deck features cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to maintain card advantage and board control.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive play with efficient creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Using powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester, along with disruption from cards like Duress and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to control the board while dealing consistent damage. Mutavault and Blightstep Pathway provide additional versatility and mana fixing, allowing for a smooth curve of threats. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and force the opponent to react while maintaining a strong board presence.

The inclusion of cards like Mutavault, Monstrous Rage, and Shadowspear provides additional versatility and ways to push damage through. This deck thrives on being proactive and putting pressure on the opponent from the start.

It aims to put pressure on the opponent from the beginning of the game and maintain that pressure throughout, utilizing cards like Burst Lightning, Lightning Strike, and Monstrous Rage. The inclusion of cards like Den of the Bugbear and Shadowspear also adds versatility and additional damage potential. Overall, the strategy revolves around relentless aggression and quick finishes.
